# 99 Reflections

Learn and reflect on the 99 Names of Allah, and read the Qur’an in Arabic and English.

## Learning resources
- [All 99 Names](https://99namesofallah.org/names/): Arabic, English meanings, reflections, and Qur’an connections.
- [Names by theme](https://99namesofallah.org/themes/): Related Names grouped for study.
- [Qur’an](https://99namesofallah.org/quran/): All 114 surahs; Tanzil Uthmani Arabic and Pickthall English.
- [Learning activities](https://99namesofallah.org/learning-mode/): Guided lessons, flashcards, and Arabic practice.
- [About](https://99namesofallah.org/about/): Educational purpose and contact.
